assertions.name: legacy write still reaches repo without CodeSite context
raw safeWriteFile is no longer exported
allowed direct write records CodeSiteFS event before mutation
allowed direct write lands after preflight
direct service write preserves line provenance evidence
mixed batch is rejected by CodeSiteFS
mixed batch does not partially write allowed files
rename into symlink parent is blocked before move
symlink escape block preserves source and outside directory
inside-repo symlink aliases cannot bypass write-set paths
symlink alias block prevents canonical target mutation
syncFile and deleteItem mutate only after CodeSiteFS records events
required service boundary fails closed without CodeSite context
missing-context directory create does not touch repo

scenarios.name: Legacy direct write
notes: No CodeSite context was supplied, preserving ordinary user edit compatibility.

scenarios.name: CodeSite direct write
notes: The control-plane write set was loaded before the file changed.

scenarios.name: Mixed batch preflight
notes: The allowed file remained unchanged because one batch member was outside the authoritative write set.

scenarios.name: Symlink parent rename
notes: The target path matched the declared write set but failed realpath containment.

scenarios.name: Inside-repo symlink alias
notes: The lexical path matched the write set, but the canonical repo path was different, so the shared resolver denied it.

scenarios.name: Sync and delete primitives
notes: Both non-writeFile CRUD primitives recorded through CodeSiteFS with their own tools and evidence refs.

scenarios.name: Required boundary without context
notes: A caller can require CodeSiteFS even when no context is supplied, and the service fails closed.
